item.title: Thursday 4 PM Update, Nov 5
item.description:

item.title: Thursday 1 PM Update, Nov 5

item.title: Thursday 10 AM Update, Nov 5
item.description:

item.title: Thursday Morning, Nov 5
item.description:
The Thursday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 5, 2026: Londonderry weather with the full seven-day forecast; where the uncalled races stand, including Alaska's Senate count; Vice President Vance says the Iran war cost Republicans the election; a deadly overnight fire in Brooklyn; Iran's negotiator says Americans voted "no to war" as Qatar waits on answers; Armenia says it's done with a Russian-led military alliance; futures split as chip stocks slide again, plus Arm, Qualcomm and the Bank of England; Amazon swaps Grubhub for Uber Eats; Claude Code's product lead moves to OpenAI and a humanoid robot maker goes public; an Android flaw that can trap phones in a reboot loop, and a Russian campaign against phones; your X feed; the Wild River Fire in the White Mountains and weekend events in town; and a six-year-old found safe in the Kentucky hills. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Wednesday 4 PM Update, Nov 4
item.description:
The Wednesday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 4, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow; Speaker Mike Johnson steps aside as House Republican leader, with Steve Scalise and Jim Jordan running to replace him; President Trump says he'd launch the Iran war again as Senator Schumer says it "must end"; Iran's leaders dismiss hopes of a U.S. shift, while Qatar awaits answers on a new proposal; Spain's economy minister takes over transport after a deadly crash; the Dow's best day since April 2025 and Qualcomm's results; Waymo's break from Uber and Canva's layoffs; Tencent's new A.I. model and a lawsuit over A.I. plate readers; DreamHost's breach and a phishing scheme that gets past two-factor codes; your X feed; a fight over New Hampshire's next chief justice; and good news for a baby elephant in Oregon. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
